changes.evidence: Team X/Weapon X and Alpha Flight are both pre-series backstory in TAS. He served in Weapon X's squad and then in Alpha Flight, and he left Alpha Flight before joining the X-Men. Both appear only in flashbacks (S3E19) or as captors (S2E5 = episode 21, where Alpha Flight captures him and then helps him escape, and he refuses to rejoin). He never holds either membership during a title on file, so remove both TAS stages. The '97 S2 Team X stage is correct: in episode 15 he recruits his old Team X squad, and then he returns to the X-Men.

In X-Men '97 episode 3, after the X-Cutioner's blast takes her powers, 'a shell-shocked Storm decided to leave the team' and travels to Texas, where she meets Forge. In episode 6 she regains her powers. By episode 10 she is back, leading the Gold Team. In episode 16 Xavier names her headmistress. No stage records the departure or the return.

At the end of the TAS Phoenix/Dark Phoenix saga (episode 43, 'The Fate of the Phoenix'), Jean dies and the remorseful Phoenix resurrects her, 'which then left'. The entity departs from Jean and the X-Men, and its own step says they part on the Moon. In '97 episode 10 it only rises in Jean briefly and then fades away. The last stage should not keep it in the X-Men.

In Deadpool & Wolverine, Wade joins the Resistance in the Void ('Deadpool inserted himself onto the team'). Back home, he tells Peter to 'clock him out forever' at Drive Max, confirming his return to being a superhero. Afterwards he 'continued to work for the TVA' (MCU wiki infobox: Drive Max, Resistance and X-Force all marked formerly, TVA current). He also briefly accepted Paradox's TVA offer at the start before defecting, which this list leaves out. If the owner does not accept the TVA ending, the last stage is ['Independent','Deadpool & Wolverine'] instead (see owner_calls).

After Cassandra Nova falls, B-15 frees the Resistance from the Void and returns its members to their homes, which disbands the team. Laura instead chooses to stay with Logan in Wade's universe and joins Wade's friends for dinner. The MCU wiki infobox lists the Resistance as 'formerly'.

owner_calls.question: After saving his universe, does Wade end Deadpool & Wolverine working for the TVA, or with no group?
options: ['The TVA','Deadpool & Wolverine'] as the last stage (MCU wiki: 'continued to work for the TVA', TVA listed as current affiliation)
['Independent','Deadpool & Wolverine'] as the last stage (he quits Drive Max, but TVA employment is only implied by the post-credits scene)
owner_calls.evidence: Either way he leaves Drive Max ('clock me out forever'). Only the final stage is in question.

owner_calls.question: Should Laura get a Logan stage for rejoining the other X-23 children, who head together for Eden and cross into Canada?
options: Add ['X-23 Children','Logan'] as the first stage
Leave as is (the children are not a formal group, and she escaped with them before the film)
owner_calls.evidence: The X-Men Movies wiki gives her affiliation as 'X-23 Children'. In Logan she reaches the children's group in North Dakota and leaves with them for Canada.

owner_calls.question: In X-Men '97 episode 3 (step status Imprisoned), the real Jean is held captive by Mister Sinister until she escapes. Should this be a captor stage?
options: Add a Sinister captor stage (e.g. ['The Nasty Boys',"X-Men '97"]) followed by ['The X-Men',"X-Men '97"] before X-Corp
Leave as is (the captivity began offscreen, and she escapes in the same episode she appears)
owner_calls.evidence: The marvelanimated wiki says Jean escapes Sinister and reaches the X-Mansion in '97. Her clone Madelyne had been living her life.

owner_calls.question: Should brief in-episode walkouts and kidnappings in the animated X-Men records become stages? Examples: Wolverine quits the X-Men and returns with Jubilee in episode 61 (Silver Samurai village), and leaves for the Weapon X ruins in S3E19. The same pattern covers other kidnappings: the Nasty Boys take Scott and Jean on their honeymoon (episode 15), Sauron takes Storm (episode 39), Alpha Flight takes Wolverine (episode 21).
options: Add X-Men -> Independent/captor -> X-Men stage pairs for each
Leave as is (each is reversed within the same episode or arc, so the net state is unchanged)
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database: 'he decided that he was no longer fit to be an X-Man. He left ... decided to return with her to the X-Men' (TAS S4E13). Every record uses the single title 'X-Men: The Animated Series' for these.

owner_calls.question: This record is the X-Force team itself. The team is wiped out on its first jump in Deadpool 2 and is gone by Deadpool & Wolverine (step status Retired). Should the team record get a disband stage?
options: Leave as is (team records keep their own name)
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki: 'almost all the members of the X-Force were killed when parachuting'. Shatterstar and Peter are listed with X-Force as 'formerly'.
